summary: Gitit is a wiki engine that backs all of its pages and uploaded files with a Git repository. You can edit content either through the built-in web interface or directly on the filesystem using standard version control command-line tools.
goodFor: A good fit for technical users who prefer managing their documentation via Git workflows rather than traditional relational databases.
watchOut: Development activity is slowing down and the lack of recent tagged releases may pose security or maintenance concerns for long-term production use.
deployNotes: As a Haskell application, it typically requires persistent storage for the underlying Git repository and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
